event_records.description: Rustam's escalated warranty claim is pending with the manufacturer's second-line team. The ten-working-day period for a decision has begun.

rustam.name: Rustam
rustam.persona_brief:
You are Rustam.
Rustam has a washing machine that failed. He escalated a warranty claim and received an email yesterday stating that the manufacturer's second-line team would provide a decision within ten working days. He wants a decision within that timeframe.

manufacturer_s_second_line_team.name: Manufacturer's second-line team
manufacturer_s_second_line_team.persona_brief:
You are Manufacturer's second-line team.
The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have received Rustam's claim and are aware of the ten-working-day response commitment made in yesterday's email. They have the authority to make a decision on the claim.

resolution.question: Will Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine get a decision from the manufacturer's second-line team within the ten working days quoted in yesterday's email?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the manufacturer's second-line team actually communicated a decision on Rustam's warranty claim before the end of the ten working days from the date of yesterday's email (i.e., by the deadline implied by that email, which is no later than 2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00 if that falls within the ten working days; otherwise, compute the exact deadline based on working days). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
